Here's Flaviar's return and refund policy:
General Return Policy
Flaviar does not offer returns based on taste preferences or change of heart. However, if you experience a problem with your order, you can report it within 7 days of the delivery date.
Order Cancellation & Refunds
You can cancel an order for a full refund within three days of purchase, provided it has not shipped yet. Once a shipping label is created, cancellation is no longer possible.
Non-Refundable Items
The following items are non-refundable and cannot be returned:
Personalized items (e.g., engraved bottles)
Pre-orders
Special releases
Seasonal products (such as the Whiskey Advent Calendar)
EU Customers Exception
If you ordered via the EU website (eu.flaviar.com), you can return products within 14 days from the delivery date according to EU regulations. You are responsible for the costs of postage and packaging for these returns.
Reporting Issues
If you have a problem with your order, contact support within 7 days of delivery and include:
Your order number
